a.lede: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.
a.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI

b.lede: Pizza Bot runs locally and lets users interact with AI agents in an email-like interface. Perfect for blowing them off just like your human colleagues!
b.title: Your AI agents' reports and questions have a new inbox, courtesy of AWS
